title: Expense Agent: align legacy submit cleanup with 29.0
summary: The Expense Agent's legacy submit action cleanup lifecycle on main is aligned with the 29.0 release by updating the preprocessor guard and obsolete tag from version 30 to 29.
key_points: Preprocessor guard changed from CLEAN30 to CLEAN29
Compatibility action and its forwarding behavior remain unchanged
Aligns main branch with 29.x and 29.0 release branches
